title: Why sitting is bad for health?

vocabulary.meaning: a way of life involving long periods of sitting and little physical activity
examples: Sedentary lifestyle is an important idea when discussing why sitting is bad for health?.
Learning about sedentary lifestyle can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: the position in which a person holds their body while sitting, standing, or moving
examples: People often have different views about posture when discussing why sitting is bad for health?.
Understanding posture can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: the movement of blood around the body
examples: The topic of why sitting is bad for health? raises useful questions about circulation.
We can discuss how circulation affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: a lack of enough movement or exercise for good health
examples: Physical inactivity can play an important role in debates about why sitting is bad for health?.
Different countries may deal with physical inactivity in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: reduced strength in one or more muscles
examples: A discussion about why sitting is bad for health? can include the effects of muscle weakness.
Knowing the meaning of muscle weakness makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: the health of the heart and blood vessels
examples: Cardiovascular health is useful vocabulary for talking about why sitting is bad for health?.
We can use the idea of cardiovascular health to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
